key_insight: Scalable compilation of optimized taper states makes high-confidence quantum phase estimation more resource-efficient, with failure probability decreasing double exponentially in the number of confidence qubits.
engineering_relevance: Precompiled taper-state preparation circuits reduce implementation overhead and enable small-scale demonstrations of tapered quantum phase estimation on near-term hardware.
method: Use p = l + m ancillas, separating phase-resolution qubits from confidence qubits.
Apply tensor-network methods to compile optimally concentrated DPSS (Slepian) taper states.
Provide resource-efficient preparation circuits for l = 1–50 and m = 1–4.
evidence_signal: On Quantinuum H2-2, tapered QPE for a one-qubit system initialized in its ground state demonstrated 3×–18× reductions in failure probability for l = 1–10.
watch_item: Hardware validation covers a one-qubit system and small registers; performance for larger circuits and more complex systems remains to be established.
paper_title: Scalable Compilation of Resource-Efficient Tapers for High-Confidence Quantum Phase Estimation
